{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("Unique channels:", df['channel'].unique())
print("Unique statuses:", df['status'].unique())
print("Revenues (first 5):", df['revenue'].head(5).tolist())
print("Revenue distribution:", df['revenue'].describe())
print("QA order count (revenue = 999999.99):", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())
print("Refunded order count:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())
print("Missing age (age = -1):", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
